Készítettem egy nagyon részletes, angol nyelvű leírást a fejedről és a hajadról, amit bemásolhatsz a kép­generáló modellnek.[1][2]

### Másolható angol prompt

"Hyper‑realistic portrait of a young adult man with a very slim, elongated oval face and prominent high cheekbones, overall quite narrow and delicate bone structure, very pale smooth skin with a neutral tone and only a few tiny natural blemishes on the forehead, almost no facial hair except the faintest soft shadow around the upper lip and chin, medium‑sized almond‑shaped brown eyes set at an average distance apart with slightly downturned outer corners and a calm neutral gaze directly at the viewer, upper eyelids not very deep‑set with a smooth lid and subtle natural crease, lower eyelids softly defined with mild natural under‑eye shadow, straight medium‑thickness dark brown eyebrows that are tidy and groomed, beginning close to the inner corners of the eyes and tapering slightly toward the outside with a gentle natural arch in the outer third, a relatively high smooth forehead without wrinkles, straight narrow nose with a gentle almost flat bridge, not hooked, and a small but clearly defined tip and slightly narrow nostrils, medium‑sized ears that stick out a little from the sides of the head with a slightly pointed upper curve giving a subtle elf‑like look, medium‑sized mouth with a straight relaxed line and a neutral expression, upper lip a bit thinner than the fuller lower lip, lips naturally soft and matte light pink, not glossy or overlined, sharp but slender jawline that runs almost straight down from the ears and then angles into a narrow slightly pointed chin, neck long and slim, hair is straight and fine, styled in a modern short‑sides longer‑top cut with the sides and back clipped very short and close to the scalp (almost a fade) while the top is several centimeters long, combed back and slightly to one side in a smooth, sleek shape without visible parting lines, front section lifted very slightly away from the forehead but still lying close to the head, hair color is pure cool platinum white, almost icy silver blonde, evenly bleached from roots to ends with no visible darker roots, giving a very bright, icy, reflective look, overall appearance minimalistic, clean and modern, no beard, wearing a simple black crew‑neck T‑shirt or a black bomber jacket."[2][3][4][5][6][1]

### Használati tipp

Nyugodtan egészítsd ki a prompt végét ilyenekkel, hogy „front‑facing, neutral expression, soft studio lighting, ultra‑realistic photo, 4K detail”, hogy még fotószerűbb legyen az eredmény.[7][1][2]

Ha szeretnéd, a következő körben tudok neked külön promptot írni más szögekre is (oldalnézet, félprofil stb.), ugyanilyen részletességgel.[3][4][8]
